participant_background.coders: All three had NLP, RAG, or experimental-methodology research backgrounds.
participant_background.adjudicator: More senior than the three coders in relevant research experience.

recruitment: Targeted invitation through the authors' professional collaborator network.
compensation: All four participants were compensated under a pre-agreed arrangement.
training: Participants read the frozen v2 codebook, completed a pilot, and aligned boundary rules without seeing model labels.
annotation_materials: Published-Claim Comparability Audit Codebook v2 (2026-07-14), exact quotations, source links, sections, and page locations.
adjudication_protocol: The adjudicator independently checked all 80 source claims before consulting the three coder labels and rationales and issuing final labels.

consent.scope: Paper analysis and public release of de-identified annotations.

ethics_review.status: Project owner reports an institutional determination of exemption or non-human-subjects status.

source: Project-owner confirmation in the Copilot CLI session on 2026-07-14
